about: Multi step requests with labels. 'sample' questions use the synthetic dataset (Alpha, Beta, Gamma); 'course' questions use the course dataset. A label left out is not scored. 'chosen' is the option the Decision critic should pick; 'infeasible' says whether the manager's limits cannot all be met.
